outline:
本課程旨在培養學生於土木與營建專案中進行風險辨識、評估與管理之能力。課程重點包含專案風險管理流程、成本與工期不確定性、風險導向估價、量化風險分析、風險因應策略，以及專題導向之實務應用。
This course aims to equip civil engineering students with the ability to identify, assess, and manage risks in construction and infrastructure projects. The course emphasizes project risk management processes, cost and schedule uncertainty, risk based estimation, quantitative risk analysis, risk response planning, and practical applications through project based learning.
schedule:
Chapter 1: Introduction to Risk Management in Civil Engineering
Chapter 2: Project Life Cycle and Sources of Uncertainty
Chapter 3: Project Objectives, Stakeholders, and Risk Context
Chapter 4: Risk Management Frameworks and Processes
Chapter 5: Risk Identification Techniques and Risk Breakdown Structure
Chapter 6: Risk Structuring, Risk Ownership, and Risk Allocation
Chapter 7: Cost and Schedule Estimation Fundamentals
Midterm Project: Risk Identification and Risk Register Development
Chapter 8: Base Cost, Base Variability, and Estimation Uncertainty
Chapter 9: Risk Elicitation, Expert Judgment, and Cognitive Biases
Chapter 10: Quantitative Risk Analysis and Probability Concepts
Chapter 11: Monte Carlo Simulation for Construction Projects
Chapter 12: Risk Response Planning and Value Engineering
Chapter 13: Risk Monitoring, Risk Control, and Project Governance
Chapter 14: Integrated Construction Risk Management Case Studies
Final Project: Comprehensive Risk Management Plan for a Civil Engineering Project

flexible_learning.content: 第17週：採非同步遠距教學。學生於北科 i 學園 PLUS 觀看教師上傳之數位影音教材，並閱讀指定學習資料。第18週：採非同步遠距教學。學生於北科 i 學園 PLUS 完成指定學習任務及線上學習成果檢核，不進行實體面授。
flexible_learning.outcome: 學生須於指定期限內完成數位教材觀看，並依課程要求完成線上測驗、學習單或指定作業。系統觀看紀錄及學習成果繳交紀錄作為學習成效檢核依據。
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: 線上教材學習及學習成果檢核占學期總成績 10%。

assessment:
Class Participation and Discussion — 20%
Midterm Project: Risk Identification and Assessment Report — 25%
Final Project: Comprehensive Risk Management Plan — 35%
Final Project Presentation — 10%
Flexible learning activities — 10%
